blocks.raw: <Tip>Memory aid: Surface prep is 90% of paint success. If sanding isn't done to 220-grit and dust-free, the best paint will fail. Humidity >50% and temperature <10°C during application = delay the work. ASTM D3359 rating 3 is acceptable minimum; rating 5 is complete failure.</Tip>

props.mistake: Sanding drywall with 120-grit paper and skipping dust removal before priming
props.correction: Use 220-grit or higher per ASTM D3276 and wipe surfaces dust-free. Dust prevents adhesion and causes delamination within 12 months.

props.mistake: Applying paint to gypsum drywall without primer in high-humidity bathrooms
props.correction: Prime with fungicide-treated primer (e.g., Boysen fungicide-rich primers) before topcoat. Unprimed drywall absorbs moisture and promotes mold.
